card.name: Digits inside numbers in data tables
card.fires_on: Single digits or decimal points partway through a multi-digit number, mostly in tables of results, statistics, or measurements. The number is not finished yet.

modes.label: Digits in result tables
modes.description: A digit or decimal point in the middle of a value in a table of study results.

modes.label: Digits in dose ranges
modes.description: The first digit of a number inside a dose range in running text.
modes.example: if the calculated dose is between <<4>>05 mg and 495

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a number, mainly in data tables, before the number is complete.
